item: December 2019 unit split on both ETFs
detail: Published terms: NIFTYBEES sub-division from Rs 10 to Re 1 (1:10); GOLDBEES sub-division from Rs 100 to Re 1 (1:100); record date 2019-12-20; ex-date 2019-12-19. Yahoo lists no split action for either ticker, and its adjusted closes on 2019-12-19 and 2019-12-20 are on a basis one split ratio too low (the two ex-split days were divided by the ratio a second time). Correction: multiply the close on those two days by the published ratio. NIFTYBEES.NS: 2019-12-19 13.020 -> 130.20; 2019-12-20 13.034 -> 130.34. GOLDBEES.NS: 2019-12-19 0.3355 -> 33.55; 2019-12-20 0.3365 -> 33.65.
